scope: Additive Angry Jelly L1-10 attachment, Brainwash and attack-range audit; preserve sourced duration and dated range without inventing target or tick ordering.

sources.title: Temperamental Tentacles Update!
facts: Angry Jelly flies and has a long-range attack; while attached it forces its Hero to target Defenses only and cannot be targeted, damaged or trigger traps.
When the Hero is eliminated or Brainwash ends, Jelly detaches and becomes a targetable, trap-triggering troop.
Brainwash lasts 25 seconds at L1-4, 30 seconds at L5-9 and 35 seconds at L10 in the launch table.
sources.limitations: The publication omits attachment start tick, initial defense selection, pathing, effect expiration order, detached target priority and projectile timing.
